polityNote: Republic of Cape Verde (independent 1975-07-05). First-level units are the concelhos (municípios); islands and the Barlavento/Sotavento groups are not administrative. Atoms: the 32 freguesias of geoBoundaries CPV ADM2 (OCHA ROWCA, 2020, CC BY 3.0 IGO); every concelho change since independence moved whole freguesias. ① Atom area (km², spherical) vs Statoids area: Boa Vista 634/620, Brava 66/67, Maio 274/269, Sal 220/216, Porto Novo 563/558, Ribeira Grande 168/167, Paul 56/54, Fogo 472/476, Praia before 1993 388/396, Santa Cruz before 2005 149/149, Tarrafal before 1996 198/203, São Vicente 269/227, São Nicolau 346/388, Santa Catarina with São Salvador do Mundo 272/243; country 3,999/3,985 (1.00). The three outliers are lines inside one island (Santiago) or published areas that omit islets; no source records a parish transfer.
